title: June 25th, 2026 KPN Webinar Recording Now LIVE
summary: Unable to join today's Knowledge Portal Network webinar on T1GRS?
bodyHtml:
Emily Griffin, from the Gaulton Lab at UCSD, presented on T1GRS: A Machine Learning Model for Determining T1D Risk and Heterogeneity

Top 3 questions T1GRS can answer:

  1. How is an individual’s T1D risk shaped by the full landscape of T1D-associated variants?
  2. How do interactions between risk variants improve identification of at-risk individuals?
  3. How can we use genetic risk profiles to identify disease heterogeneity with real differences in clinical outcomes?

Watch the recording here: https://youtu.be/xHsC3JEozkM
